classification_system: Planning Commission / ICAR National Agro-Climatic Zones of India

Western Himalayan Region.thermal_regime: Cold temperate to sub-tropical in lower valleys
Western Himalayan Region.characteristics: High topographic variation, cold winters, valley irrigation, terraced slopes.

Eastern Himalayan Region.characteristics: High rainfall, acidic soils, flood-prone river basins, extensive biodiversity.

Lower Gangetic Plain Region.thermal_regime: Hot and humid summers, mild winters
Lower Gangetic Plain Region.characteristics: High soil fertility, high water table, multiple paddy cycles (Aman, Aus, Boro).

Middle Gangetic Plain Region.thermal_regime: Sub-tropical monsoon, hot summers, cool winters
Middle Gangetic Plain Region.characteristics: Deep fertile alluvium, canal and tube-well irrigation, intense cropping intensity.

Upper Gangetic Plain Region.thermal_regime: Semi-arid to sub-humid, hot summer, cold winter
Upper Gangetic Plain Region.characteristics: Extensive irrigation infrastructure, intensive green revolution agriculture.

Trans-Gangetic Plain Region.thermal_regime: Semi-arid continental, extreme summer heat, chilly winters
Trans-Gangetic Plain Region.characteristics: Highest tube-well and canal irrigation coverage in India, high yield productivity.

Eastern Plateau and Hills.characteristics: Undulating terrain, predominantly rainfed agriculture, tribal farming, iron/aluminum rich soils.

Central Plateau and Hills.thermal_regime: Semi-arid to sub-humid, hot dry summer
Central Plateau and Hills.characteristics: Malwa and Bundelkhand plateaus, pulses and oilseed heartland of India.

Western Plateau and Hills.characteristics: Deccan basalt trap (Vertisols), high moisture-retentive capacity, drought vulnerability in rainfed pockets.

Southern Plateau and Hills.thermal_regime: Semi-arid tropical, hot summer, mild dry winter
Southern Plateau and Hills.characteristics: Tank and borewell irrigation, red sandy soils requiring regular organic carbon replenishment.

East Coast Plains and Hills.thermal_regime: Maritime tropical, high humidity, cyclonic depressions
East Coast Plains and Hills.characteristics: Delta systems of Mahanadi, Godavari, Krishna, Cauvery; northeast monsoon precipitation.

West Coast Plains and Ghats.thermal_regime: Humid maritime tropical, heavy southwest monsoon
West Coast Plains and Ghats.characteristics: Steep rainfall gradient, plantation agriculture, acidic laterites, high organic matter in ghats.

states: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
Gujarat Plains and Hills.characteristics: High commercial cotton and oilseed production, drip irrigation adoption, salinity in coastal/Rann zones.

Western Dry Region.thermal_regime: Arid, intense solar radiation, extreme diurnal temp fluctuation
Western Dry Region.characteristics: Thar desert ecosystem, drought-hardy pulses, Indira Gandhi Canal irrigated corridors.

Islands Region.thermal_regime: Equatorial maritime, warm and humid throughout year
Islands Region.characteristics: Island ecology, coconut and plantation dominance, coastal fishing and agroforestry.
